analysis.title: Hess Midstream LP (HESM): First Take: 3Q26 Slight Beat as Margins and MVC Support Offset Volume Softness
key_insights: HESM (Sell) reported 3Q26 adj. EBITDA of $320m, above GSe of $315m and FactSet consensus of $313m (+2% vs each). Higher implied fees across segments (likely including MVC support on crude gathering and terminaling) and lower Gathering and Terminaling opex more than offset softer volumes.

Volumes were below GSe across most streams, partly reflecting planned maintenance at LM4 during the quarter. Gas gathering was 438 mmcf/d (-6% vs GSe 465, -2% QoQ), gas processing 427 mmcf/d (-5% vs GSe 449, -1% QoQ), crude gathering 107 kb/d (-7% vs GSe 115, +4% QoQ), crude terminaling 117 kb/d (-5% vs GSe 123, flat QoQ). Water gathering was 131 kb/d (+2% vs GSe 128, +8% QoQ).

Crude gathering (107 kb/d vs 2026 MVC of 111 kb/d) and crude terminaling (117 kb/d vs MVC of 118 kb/d) both ran below their 2026 minimum volume commitments, so the implied fee rate rose as MVC payments supported margins.
FCF was $248m vs GSe of $224m on stronger EBITDA and lower capex. Capex was $22m vs GSe of $37m as spend normalized after completion of the gas compression expansion.

2026 guidance: Adj. EBITDA lowered at the top end to $1,225-1,250m from $1,225-1,275m (midpoint $1,238m vs GSe $1,249m and consensus $1,242m). Adj. FCF lowered to $910-935m from $910-960m (GSe $921m). Throughput guidance fell ~3-4% across gas, crude and water, consistent with 1H26 volumes already running below guidance. The cut was announced with the CVX restructuring on October 6 and reiterated with 3Q26 results.

Preliminary pro-forma 2027 guidance (post-close): Adj. EBITDA of $850-950m (-27% YoY at the midpoint vs revised 2026 guidance) and Adj. FCF of $525-625m (-38% YoY). No incremental 2027 detail was given, and more is expected after the CVX transaction closes.

Capital returns: the quarterly distribution was raised 5% annualized to $0.7985 ahead of earnings (GSe $0.7987). No buybacks were announced. Management guides to +5% annualized distribution growth through 4Q26, with 2027 distributions held flat at the 4Q26 level.
Management reiterated its expectation that the CVX transaction closes by YE26. GS estimates are unchanged and exclude the pending transaction.

GS focus items: 1) detail on the pending CVX transaction and YE26 close, 2) the 2027+ EBITDA and FCF bridge, including fixed system reservation fees and deferred revenue accounting, 3) Bakken activity read-through as CVX goes from three rigs to two in December 2026, with ~5% 2027 volume decline and 2028 plateau, 4) DJ Basin integration and capex, 5) the path to 3.75x-4.0x post-close leverage and the long-term 3.5-3.75x target.

Valuation: Sell, 12-month price target $33 (stock $32.25, 2.3% upside). The target blends a fundamental value (7.75x 2027 EBITDA, 85% weight) with an M&A component (8.75x 2027 EBITDA, 15% weight). M&A rank is 2.

market_movers.rationale: Slight 3Q26 beat on margins and MVC support, but volumes missed and 2026 EBITDA guidance was trimmed. Price target of $33 is only 2.3% above the $32.25 close.

earnings_insights: HESM 3Q26 reported adj. EBITDA $320m vs GSe $315m and FactSet consensus $313m (+2% each). 2Q26 actual was $314m.
HESM 3Q26 reported FCF $248m vs GSe $224m. Reported capex $22m vs GSe $37m and $31m in 2Q26.
HESM 2026 adj. EBITDA guidance now $1,225-1,250m (prior $1,225-1,275m) vs GSe $1,249m and consensus $1,242m. 2026 adj. FCF guidance now $910-935m (prior $910-960m) vs GSe $921m.
HESM preliminary pro-forma 2027 guidance (post CVX transaction close): adj. EBITDA $850-950m and adj. FCF $525-625m.
GS forecasts for HESM (estimates): 2026E EBITDA $1,249.4m, 2027E $1,283.1m, 2028E $1,293.6m. EPS $2.94 for 2026E, $3.15 for 2027E and $3.30 for 2028E. These exclude the pending CVX transaction.
risk_factors: Upside risks to the Sell thesis: 1) a high-multiple takeout by CVX, 2) higher oil prices and higher CVX activity levels, 3) higher-than-expected capital returns, 4) stronger growth in third-party volumes.
Volumes ran below guidance in 1H26 and below GS estimates in 3Q26, and the guided ~5% 2027 volume decline and 2028 plateau tie growth to CVX Bakken activity.
Pro-forma 2027 EBITDA and FCF are guided sharply lower, and the bridge, including reservation fees and deferred revenue accounting, is not yet clear.
Leverage is expected to rise to 3.75x-4.0x post-close vs a long-term target of 3.5-3.75x.
